author: A. Patel
title: Worth the measured size
body: We measured the living room in feet and inches and the 8 by 10 landed with a border of floor, as the page said.

author: M. Alvarez
title: Color matched the swatch
body: The apricot is softer in the room than on a phone, which is what we wanted next to a linen sofa.

author: J. Brooks
title: Arrived from New Jersey
body: The Elizabeth warehouse shipped to Brooklyn in the window they named. No surprise freight bill.

author: S. Nguyen
title: Runner fits the hall
body: The 2 by 10 left a gap at each baseboard. The door still clears the end.

author: R. Cohen
title: Washable did wash
body: Cold cycle, low dry. The stone stripe still looks even after a muddy week.

author: L. Ibrahim
title: Vintage was one piece
body: They did not offer to cut it, which we appreciated. The size on the page was the rug.

author: A. Patel
title: Sofa sits on the rug
body: Front legs on the 9 by 12, coffee table fully on it. The scale note was right.

author: M. Alvarez
title: Quote before the wash
body: Cleaning was quoted from the measured size, not a flat fee. The rug came back dry.

author: J. Brooks
title: Fringe repair was honest
body: They said the field was sound and only the fringe needed work. That is what they did.

author: S. Nguyen
title: Delivery up one flight
body: Stairs were a separate line on the quote. The crew placed the rug and left the hallway clear.

author: R. Cohen
title: Pile is even
body: Medium pile, not the floppy high pile some photos suggest. It lies flat.

author: L. Ibrahim
title: Navy runner hides dust
body: A hall with a dog. The navy field does not show every print.

author: A. Patel
title: Medallion is centered
body: We centered the sofa on the medallion. The border still showed on all four sides.

author: M. Alvarez
title: Oak table on the rug
body: The coffee table sits fully on the field. No half-on, half-off look.

author: J. Brooks
title: Chair legs on the rug
body: Both front legs land on the rug with the sofa. The group reads as one.

author: S. Nguyen
title: Indigo holds up at night
body: Lamps on, the ivory medallion still reads. It does not turn gray.

author: R. Cohen
title: Kilim under a door
body: Flatweave was the right call where the door swings. A thick pile would have caught.

author: L. Ibrahim
title: Sale price was the price
body: Checkout matched the sale price on the 8 by 10. No later adjustment.

author: A. Patel
title: Stock was real
body: The page said the New Jersey warehouse had it. It shipped, it was not a backorder.

author: M. Alvarez
title: Georgia route to Charlotte
body: Two extra days past Atlanta, which the city note warned us about.

author: J. Brooks
title: Texas humidity note
body: They held a washed rug until it was dry. We did not get a damp roll.

author: S. Nguyen
title: California hillside quote
body: The quote separated the curb drop from the steps. We approved the steps.

author: R. Cohen
title: Side table scale
body: Small enough to sit on the rug beside the chair without covering the corner motif.

author: L. Ibrahim
title: Boucle and a patterned rug
body: Ivory boucle needed the rug to carry the color. The apricot Oushak does that.

author: A. Patel
title: Binding after a cut
body: They declined to cut the vintage one and bound a newer wool piece instead. Correct call.

author: M. Alvarez
title: Review after a month
body: The wool has not shed past the first week. Traffic shows less than I expected.

author: J. Brooks
title: Measured twice
body: The 5 by 7 is a real 5 by 7, not a rounded trade size. It fits the bedside plan.

author: S. Nguyen
title: Service email was specific
body: The cleaning reply named fiber and the unstable-dye check. It was not a form letter.

author: R. Cohen
title: Furniture blanket wrap
body: The sofa arrived blanket wrapped from the warehouse, not in a torn carton on a porch.

author: L. Ibrahim
title: Would order the next size up
body: We almost bought the 8 by 10 and were glad the area price for the 9 by 12 was spelled out.
